title: Image-level last-block LoRA PEFT screen
hypothesis: Real image augmentation plus a trust-regularized low-rank update of the final DINOv2 transformer block improves few-shot class geometry beyond the frozen RBF baseline.

reference.method: Frozen official DINOv2 ViT-B/14 CLS + sklearn RBF SVC C=3 gamma=scale using SVC.predict

peft.trainable_backbone_parameters: LoRA only on final block attn.qkv, attn.proj, mlp.fc1, mlp.fc2
peft.classifier: cosine head initialized from fold-training frozen DINO class prototypes

evaluation_arms.PEFT_HEAD: adapted deterministic CLS + trained cosine head
evaluation_arms.PEFT_RBF: adapted deterministic fold-training/evaluation CLS + RBF SVC C=3

selection_rule.confirmation: If passed, freeze the complete protocol and generate new train-only episodes 4 and 5. Official test remains locked.
